benchmark: M26 baseline with measured post-optimization comparison

frontend_graph_render.method: Measured actual Graph Explorer tab transitions in Edge on the same READY Requests v2.32.5 snapshot. Timing uses Date.now() in the page immediately before and after a UI click; row and relationship DOM counts were checked after each transition.

baseline.source: Pre-optimization baseline observation recorded before implementation changes.

measurement_limits: Browser transition timing includes click dispatch and React render, but excludes a separate accessibility-tree serialization step.
The baseline view rendered 400 rows; the optimized view renders 100 initially and expands in batches, preserving access through the Show next control.

host.memory_pressure:
The system has 17179869184 (4194304 pages with a page size of 4096).
System-wide memory free percentage: 60%

swap_monitoring_samples.interpretation: Swap use decreased over the sample window; host memory pressure remained at or above 52% free. No sustained swap-thrashing signal was observed during this workload.

measurement_limits: This report is a cold ingestion and first-time local-vector baseline for the frozen repository. It does not claim performance on other repositories.
The default long-running Compose service and its persistent volume are not used or modified; FalkorDB runs in the separate bounded ephemeral benchmark container.

Post-optimization browser measurements are for the actual local Edge UI and use progressive initial row rendering; the full request ingestion and ONNX encoding were not rerun because the implementation change only affects frontend rendering.

query.scope: In-process FastAPI TestClient; includes snapshot-context load, READY guard, graph-tool construction, query, and JSON serialization; excludes network/browser latency.

resources.docker_running_containers_ram_scope: Read-only sum of all running Docker containers at measurement time; includes the existing wemakedevs-track1 persistent service and unrelated already-running containers. The isolated M26 FalkorDB container remained separately capped at 2GiB.
